response: The tumour expression of VEGF is not associated with venous invasion in pT3 renal cell carcinoma. However, VEGF is an independent prognostic factor in this group of poor prognosis renal tumours, indicating that it can provide valuable information about patient survival. In other words, while VEGF expression does not directly correlate with the progression of the tumour into the renal vein and vena cava, it can still be used to predict patient outcomes and inform treatment decisions.
